scientific_integrity: Integral kernel and action calculated by exact finite matrices with a primitive basis; standalone verifier checks all faces and dihedral actions. The known nonequivariant wedge-of-spheres theorem is credited to Braun. No independent mathematical audit was performed.
scientific_limitations: Only the eight-point stable Kneser parameter is treated; general integral equivariance, quotient torsion, and equivariant homotopy types are unproved. Equivalent unindexed literature is possible.
title: The integral dihedral homology lattice of the first eight-point stable Kneser independence complex
